Name: Door
Description: A leaf that swings out of its own doorway. Solid while it is shut, because that is what a door is for; opening it moves the leaf aside rather than making it insubstantial, and the opening it leaves is what changes what you can hear through it. A room door: its +Z face is the corridor or the street, and it is pushed from there and swings into the room (PushSide 1); from inside it is pulled.
